title: Inhibitory Effects of Artificial Sweeteners on Bacterial Quorum Sensing.
authors: Markus, Victor; Share, Orr; Shagan, Marilou; Halpern, Barak; Bar, Tal; Kramarsky-Winter, Esti; Terali, Kerem; Ozer, Nazmi; Marks, Robert S; Kushmaro, Ariel; Golberg, Karina
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接等方法探究人工甜味剂对细菌群体感应系统LasR蛋白的抑制作用，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为细菌群体感应蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Despite having been tagged as safe and beneficial, recent evidence remains inconclusive regarding the status of artificial sweeteners and their putative effects on gut microbiota. Gut microorganisms are essential for the normal metabolic functions of their host. These microorganisms communicate within their community and regulate group behaviors via a molecular system termed quorum sensing (QS). In the present study, we aimed to study the effects of artificial sweeteners on this bacterial communication system. Using biosensor assays, biophysical protein characterization methods, microscale thermophoresis, swarming motility assays, growth assays, as well as molecular docking, we show that aspartame, sucralose, and saccharin have significant inhibitory actions on the Gram-negative bacteria N-acyl homoserine lactone-based (AHL) communication system. Our studies indicate that these three artificial sweeteners are not bactericidal. Protein-ligand docking and interaction profiling, using LasR as a representative participating receptor for AHL, suggest that the artificial sweeteners bind to the ligand-binding pocket of the protein, possibly interfering with the proper housing of the native ligand and thus impeding protein folding. Our findings suggest that these artificial sweeteners may affect the balance of the gut microbial community via QS-inhibition. We, therefore, infer an effect of these artificial sweeteners on numerous molecular events that are at the core of intestinal microbial function, and by extension on the host metabolism.
abstract_zh: 尽管人工甜味剂已被标记为安全且有益，但关于其状态及其对肠道微生物群可能产生的影响，近期证据仍不确凿。肠道微生物对宿主正常代谢功能至关重要。这些微生物在群落内进行通信，并通过一种称为群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）的分子系统调节群体行为。在本研究中，我们旨在探讨人工甜味剂对该细菌通信系统的影响。利用生物传感器检测、生物物理蛋白质表征方法、微量热泳动、群集运动试验、生长试验以及分子对接，我们证明阿斯巴甜、三氯蔗糖和糖精对革兰氏阴性菌基于N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯（AHL）的通信系统具有显著抑制作用。我们的研究表明，这三种人工甜味剂并非杀菌剂。以LasR作为AHL的代表性参与受体进行的蛋白质-配体对接和相互作用分析表明，人工甜味剂结合到蛋白质的配体结合口袋，可能干扰天然配体的正常容纳，从而阻碍蛋白质折叠。我们的发现表明，这些人工甜味剂可能通过抑制QS影响肠道微生物群落的平衡。因此，我们推断这些人工甜味剂对肠道微生物功能核心的众多分子事件产生影响，并进而影响宿主代谢。
